case_number: 2023 INSC 662; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. …………. OF 2023 [Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 9777 Of 2022]
summary: Conviction under Section 302 IPC altered to Part-I of Section 304 IPC; homicide arose during domestic dispute over Rs.500 for NCC camp; stick used as weapon not deemed deadly; persistent marital discord with history of violence including leg fracture; court applied Exception I to Section 300 IPC; sentence served (9 years) deemed adequate; conviction for Section 201 IPC set aside; appeal allowed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction under Section 302 IPC altered to Part-I Section 304 IPC; sentence already served (9 years) deemed sufficient; bail bonds discharged.
